description: Unified Python wrapper for cryptocurrency exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, Upbit, Bithumb, Korbit) — typed, async-first, with MCP server
rules: Use the same unified API interface across all exchanges (BaseExchange)
Use context manager (with/async with) for automatic cleanup
All API responses include a .raw field for accessing original exchange data
Rate limiting is handled automatically by the HTTPClient
